additional_info.subject: Sicharge D/SG/JNBK nNWYn2- DC Meter logs full
additional_info.body:
Hi team,
Charger ID: nNWYn2
Today we had an error on outlet 1 as below:
Outlet 1: outoforder, LEMState: Error Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1222940356 status: {"value":19,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":true,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":false,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":512,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":false,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":true,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}})
As a result, outlet 1 was out of order. As a temp solution, we removed the lem meter IP address on the outlet configuration for Outlet 1 to bypass the DC meter and reinstate the outlet.
Please check what we can do to rectify this to bring back the DC meter.
Best regards,
Yasir
